citation.text_span: Worst-of Autocallable Contingent Coupon Notes with Memory linked to S&P 500 Index and S&P/TSX 60 Index · Reference SN-2026-0111 · Dated 26 May 2026
Northbridge Capital Markets (Canada) Inc. (the "Issuer") will issue notes
in an aggregate Notional Amount of USD 4,500,000.
in an aggregate Notional Amount of USD 4,500,000.
The Trade Date is 26 May 2026
the Issue Date is 2 June 2026
the Scheduled Maturity Date is 2 June 2028
S&P 500 Index (Bloomberg: SPX Index) and the S&P/TSX 60 Index (Bloomberg: SPTSX60 Index)
The Initial Level of the Underlying is 100% of its official closing level on the Trade Date.
Knock-in Event: the Notes are subject to a knock-in barrier observed on the Final Valuation Date only (European observation)
Knock-in Level of 60% of the Initial Level.
The Notes pay a conditional Coupon of 8.4% per annum
The Notes pay a conditional Coupon of 8.4% per annum
payable quarterly, payable quarterly in arrears

Memory feature: if a Coupon is not paid on a Coupon Payment Date because the Coupon Condition is not satisfied, that Coupon is not lost. It will be paid, together with the Coupon then due, on the first subsequent Coupon Payment Date on which the Coupon Condition is satisfied.
Autocall Observation Dates: 26 May 2027, 26 November 2027.
if on any Autocall Observation Date the closing level of the Underlying is at or above 100% of the Initial Level
Coupon amounts accrue on a 30/360 day count basis.
Settlement at maturity or upon automatic early redemption is in cash, in USD.
Payment dates are adjusted in accordance with the Modified Following Business Day Convention.
